items.title: Charmed S07E02 The Bare Witch Project ALTERNATE CUT
items.description: This is an alternate cut of the episode that aired on September 19, 2004. It contains a different edit of the breastfeeding scene, as well as the "Previously on Charmed" segment. Uploading it as historical reference since it has only aired on TV once so it has become lost media.
